name: redfin-mcp
description: Redfin real-estate access for Claude — search listings, fetch property details, market reports, saved homes

redfin_communities_file.title: Communities file
redfin_communities_file.description: Override the community vocabulary (JSON string array).

redfin_debug.title: Debug logging (advanced)
redfin_debug.description: Set to 1 for verbose fetchproxy transport logging to stderr.

fetchproxy_ws_host.title: fetchproxy bind address (advanced)
fetchproxy_ws_host.description: Bind interface for the fetchproxy concentrator, a literal IP only (default 127.0.0.1). Keep on loopback; it exists for hosted deployments that run each MCP in its own network namespace.

fetchproxy_identity_dir.title: fetchproxy identity directory (advanced)
fetchproxy_identity_dir.description: Absolute path where the fetchproxy long-term identity keypair is stored (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/).

tools.name: redfin_search_properties
tools.description: Search Redfin listings by location and optional filters

tools.name: redfin_get_property
tools.description: Fetch a property's full details by Redfin URL or property_id+listing_id

tools.name: redfin_get_market_report
tools.description: Market report for a Redfin region (median prices, days on market, YoY)

tools.name: redfin_get_saved_homes
tools.description: The signed-in user's favorited homes

tools.name: redfin_get_saved_searches
tools.description: The signed-in user's saved searches

tools.name: redfin_calculate_mortgage
tools.description: Local PITI mortgage-payment calculator — no network

tools.name: redfin_sweep_area
tools.description: Exhaustively enumerate Redfin for-sale listings in a lat/lng box by recursive polygon tiling under the 350-home cap, or across a list of ZIP regions (`zips` mode); reports completeness and returns the listings inline, or writes them to an optional new JSON file (`output_path`).

tools.name: redfin_get_by_address
tools.description: Resolve a free-text address to its Redfin canonical URL and home_id

tools.name: redfin_resolve_addresses
tools.description: Batch-resolve up to 100 addresses to Redfin URLs and home_ids

tools.name: redfin_get_property_photos
tools.description: Full photo gallery for a Redfin property

tools.name: redfin_get_price_history
tools.description: Listing-price events and tax history for a property

tools.name: redfin_compare_properties
tools.description: Fetch and compare 2–25 Redfin properties side-by-side

tools.name: redfin_bulk_get
tools.description: Structured fetch of up to 200 Redfin properties in one call, with per-row errors

tools.name: redfin_get_climate_risk
tools.description: First Street flood, fire and heat risk scores for a property

tools.name: redfin_get_climate_risk_bulk
tools.description: Climate risk for up to 100 properties in one call

tools.name: redfin_get_area_climate_baseline
tools.description: Averaged climate-risk baseline from 2–10 sample properties in an area

tools.name: redfin_get_comparable_rentals
tools.description: Nearby rental comparables for a property

tools.name: redfin_calculate_affordability
tools.description: Local home-affordability calculator — no network

tools.name: redfin_healthcheck
tools.description: Check the browser bridge and a redfin.com round-trip

tools.name: redfin_register_session
tools.description: Record (or refresh) which Redfin account the signed-in session belongs to

tools.name: redfin_set_active_session
tools.description: Mark a registered session_id as the current account label (label only)

tools.name: redfin_get_session_context
tools.description: List every registered account label plus the current active_session_id
